content.content: deccy new writes a schema-valid skeleton and never authors node content: kind decision, type text, ref inline with placeholder content, placeholder rationale, and depends_on naming exactly the --on ids.
content.rationale: D0 forbids the CLI from authoring node content; relaxing the schema re-opens D1d and weakens every validity gate. A placeholder skeleton keeps every birth schema-valid at creation while leaving all content decisions to the author.
